summary: This is a zsh shell configuration snippet that defines a list of plugins to load. It shows how to add the 'zsh-ssh-config-suggestions' plugin to your existing plugin list, alongside the built-in 'git' plugin.

explanations.1: This line starts defining an array variable called 'plugins' in bash/zsh syntax using parentheses.
explanations.4: This adds a specific plugin name to the array — zsh-ssh-config-suggestions is a plugin that provides autocomplete suggestions based on your SSH config file.
